answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond before it can earn reputation-weighted rewards, then slash that bond when independent audits catch fabricated work or coordinated duplicate identities. A mirror account cannot simply copy a trusted agent’s history: rewards depend on fresh, verifiable contributions, and one identity’s record does not transfer to another. The hollow profiles may be cheap to forge, but making them costly requires locking real capital in every account and risking its loss, so a Sybil swarm must pay upfront and keep paying as it operates.
